What this dataset is testing

  • Picture-only 3×3 binder-page scans rendered as JPEGs from real card art
  • Card identification from page pixels only, with no embedded SVG or per-slot metadata
  • Mild-to-severe skew, sleeve glare, soft focus, motion blur, occlusion bands, and lighting changes
  • First-edition versus unlimited recognition using side-by-side Jungle Pikachu scans
  • Adversarial near-duplicate cards and page-level hard cases intended to break the current baseline scanner
  • Binder-total and page-total pricing rollups
  • Duplicate-card aggregation
